usageNotes: Sends an ACPI shutdown signal to a remote LXC container, allowing it to shut down gracefully rather than being forcibly stopped. The caller must hold `Resource.Manage` on the remote guest resource. Returns a remote UPID — poll the task status endpoint to confirm completion before assuming the container is offline.

examples.summary: Gracefully shut down LXC container 201 on remote 'hetzner-de'

destructiveReason: Shuts down the container, interrupting all running processes and making the container's services unavailable until it is started again.
tips: Omit the `node` body parameter to let PDM resolve the node automatically; supply it only when you know the specific node hosting the container.
A graceful shutdown depends on the container's init system responding to the ACPI signal — if the container is unresponsive, use the stop (force-kill) endpoint instead.
The returned UPID is scoped to the remote cluster; use the corresponding remote task-status endpoint to track completion.
